description: OKX perpetual-swap liquidations for one underlying (e.g. BTC-USD): the most recent 100 filled forced liquidations, split into long and short liquidated USD value, with the largest events. Covers OKX only, and the window is the latest 100 events, not a fixed 24h total. Other exchanges' liquidation streams are not reported. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: crypto_crypto_liquidations_feed
title: Crypto Crypto Liquidations Feed
